text:
[ITST.6.1] Decide which suite first.

- **impl/** if the test needs to reach internal
  module state, exercises a private helper, or
  proves an internal invariant. White-box.
- **spec/** if the test verifies an externally-
  documented behavior (a specific IDSP / IDAT /
  IERR / IARC point). Black-box; only `libds.h`
  available. See [ISTS.1] for the full spec-suite
  discipline.
